entries.title: Revelation of John 2:1
segments: ¶To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: These things says he that holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lamps:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:2
segments: I know thy works and [thy] labour, and thine endurance, and that thou canst not bear evil [men]; and thou hast tried them who say that themselves [are] apostles and are not, and hast found them liars;

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:3
segments: and endurest, and hast borne for my name's sake, and hast not wearied:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:4
segments: but I have against thee, that thou hast left thy first love.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:5
segments: Remember therefore whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works: but if not, I am coming to thee, and I will remove thy lamp out of its place, except thou shalt repent.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:6
segments: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitanes, which *I* also hate.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:7
segments: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him that overcomes, I will give to him to eat of the tree of life which is in the paradise of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:8
segments: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: These things says the first and the last, who became dead, and lived:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:9
segments: I know thy tribulation and thy poverty; but thou art rich; and the railing of those who say that they themselves are Jews, and are not, but a synagogue of Satan.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:10
segments: Fear nothing [of] what thou art about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to cast of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give to thee the crown of life.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:11
segments: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He that overcomes shall in no wise be injured of the second death.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:12
segments: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Pergamos write: These things says he that has the sharp two-edged sword:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:13
segments: I know where thou dwellest, where the throne of Satan [is]; and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in the days in which Antipas my faithful witness [was], who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:14
segments: But I have a few things against thee: that thou hast there those who hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a snare before the sons of Israel, to eat [of] idol sacrifices and commit fornication.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:15
segments: So thou also hast those who hold the doctrine of Nicolaitanes in like manner.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:16
segments: Repent therefore: but if not, I come to thee quickly, and I will make war with them with the sword of my mouth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:17
segments: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him that overcomes, to him will I give of the hidden manna; and I will give to him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows but he that receives [it].

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:18
segments: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: These things says the Son of God, he that has his eyes as a flame of fire, and his feet [are] like fine brass:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:19
segments: I know thy works, and love, and faith, and service, and thine endurance, and thy last works [to be] more than the first.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:20
segments: But I have against thee that thou permittest the woman Jezebel, she who calls herself prophetess, and she teaches and leads astray my servants to commit fornication and eat of idol sacrifices.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:21
segments: And I gave her time that she should repent, and she will not repent of her fornication.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:22
segments: Behold, I cast her into a bed, and those that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of her works,

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:23
segments: and her children will I kill with death; and all the assemblies shall know that *I* am he that searches [the] reins and [the] hearts; and I will give to you each according to your works.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:24
segments: But to you I say, the rest who [are] in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, who have not known the depths of Satan, as they say, I do not cast upon you any other burden;

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:25
segments: but what ye have hold fast till I shall come.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:26
segments: And he that overcomes, and he that keeps unto the end my works, to him will I give authority over the nations,

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:27
segments: and he shall shepherd them with an iron rod; as vessels of pottery are they broken in pieces, as I also have received from my Father;

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:28
segments: and I will give to him the morning star.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:29
segments: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
